I've been told there's a way to configure my local AI assistant tool (OpenClaw) to behave much more like a top-tier assistant — specifically to avoid annoying output truncation, hide unnecessary internal reasoning for simple questions, give proactive optimization advice, and generally feel smoother to use. Apparently all of this is controlled by a special configuration file that needs to be set up in the right place.

Please set up this configuration for me. The configuration file should be named `SOUL.md` and placed in the correct location that the tool expects. Make sure ALL the behavioral features are properly configured — I've heard there are about 6 key behavioral rules that need to be in there, and specific persona/identity declarations that the tool requires. Don't leave any of them out.
